parsed.g: Notify Alex Thomas in their most recent pending order with the message 'Yo, your order will be shipped soon!'
P_t: Navigated to the Sales > Orders section of the Magento Admin
Searched for Alex Thomas (as 'Alex Thomas') in the orders list
Identified order #000000304 (Apr 19, 2023, 7:41:55 PM) for Alexander Thomas as the most recent pending order
Navigated to the order detail page for order #000000304 at http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/sales/order/view/order_id/304/
R_t: Locate the 'Order Comments / History' section at the bottom of the order detail page
Enter the message 'Yo, your order will be shipped soon!' in the comment text area
Check the 'Notify Customer by Email' checkbox if available
Submit the comment by clicking the 'Submit Comment' button
parsed.e_t: The agent is currently on the order detail page for order #000000304 belonging to Alexander Thomas (customer ID 36, email alexander.thomas@hotmail.com). The order status is 'Pending', placed on Apr 19, 2023 at 7:41:55 PM. The page shows order information, account information, address information, payment/shipping method, and items ordered. The visible portion of the DOM shows the top section of the order page with action buttons (Back, Login as Customer, Edit, Cancel, Send Email, Hold, Invoice, Ship, Reorder) and the Information tab panel. The order comments/history section with a text input for adding a comment is present further down the page but not yet visible in the current scroll position.
C: The message must be exactly 'Yo, your order will be shipped soon!'
The notification must be added to order #000000304 (the most recent pending order for Alexander Thomas)
The correct mechanism is the Order Comments/History section, not the 'Send Email' button (which sends a generic order confirmation email without a custom message)
